title: Replenishment earns the head bound before large-population asymptotics
statement: Under positive admissible constant immigration, genuine bounded-participation rank progress, bounded pure-deletion seeds, independent Cox kill of order A^m and actual bounded target-loss output, a uniform head tail is earned without assuming seed count controls lifetime. Deleted initial-label ghosts and unconditioned forcing pay seed/adverse events. Exact local scale alpha=m/(Lm+1) gives fixed moments and square-root survival integral O(n^-alpha); critical block success is constant, not superpolynomial. Stop at population<n/2, pay rare many-seed branch and earned conditional head remainder before restarting. Killed incoming-grade barrier preserves f_s(A0), grade2s/Cauchy–Schwarz and actual kill compensator give stronger output s+p with n^[-alpha p/(2p+m)], NOT a same-grade small norm. Independent progress/no-seed example with immigration proves only abstract population POWER sharpness. Pre-terminal observables at jump exits need explicit frozen pre-jump construction, not automatic optional stopping of post-jump value. Exact model clock, nonexplosion, pure seed deletion and admissible immigrants remain substantive; no raw/global transfer.

requires: Genuine non-double-counted allocated progress subgenerators, collateral safety, bounded adverse batch size and actual per-label predictable participation; regularity/nonexplosion for Dynkin localization.

Each theorem retains its own fixed-population or admissible immigration/pure-deletion seed contract, actual first-terminal stopping and output loss, frozen ordinary labels, exact trace clock and reward-weighted potential.

Uniform/null-slot reset and without-replacement sampling laws for exact carried profiles; a matching mean alone is insufficient. Abstract control converses require free nonnegative finite-rate intensities with no common upper bound.
